notes: InstallMethod::SkillsSh, global scope, requested harnesses = [] (shared universal root only, no per-harness link). Every file body under a skills/<name>/ folder fetched from a remote source (including LICENSE.txt, when present) is stored on disk as a one-line stub (`stub sha256=<original hash> bytes=<n>`), never the real third-party content; tree.json still records the ORIGINAL sha256/length, and cli_parity.rs compares against that original hash, not the stub's own bytes.
